tools.name: get_author_by_slug
tools.description: Retrieve the public authority profile and associated publications of an SEO Services author using the author's canonical public slug.

slug.description: Canonical public SEO Services author slug.

tools.name: get_category_by_slug
tools.description: Retrieve a public SEO Services editorial category and the publications associated with that category using its canonical slug.

slug.description: Canonical public SEO Services category slug.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Retrieve a public SEO Services collection. Supported collections are blog publications and services. Blog results may be requested by page.

type.description: Collection to retrieve: blog or servicos.

tools.name: get_content_by_slug
tools.description: Retrieve the canonical structured representation of a public SEO Services page, service or publication using its canonical slug.

slug.description: Canonical SEO Services content slug, for example consultoria-seo.

tools.name: get_site_index
tools.description: Discover canonical public SEO Services resources and their structured API representations. Use this tool before guessing page, service, publication, category or author slugs.
